en: The image shows a black-and-white view of a historic courtyard, dominated by a well-maintained lawn and several large trees. Surrounding the courtyard are imposing stone buildings with ornate gables and towers, covered in parts with ivy. The architectural style is distinctly Northern European, with stepped gables and decorative rooftop elements typical of Renaissance or late Gothic structures. There is no visible text on the front of the postcard.
